name: ST STM32H745I-DISCO

source_references.title: ST Discovery kits with STM32H745XI and STM32H750XB MCUs user manual

record_note: UM2488 specifies X1 as a 25 MHz oscillator for the STM32H745XIH6 and Ethernet PHY, X2 as a 32.768 kHz RTC crystal, and X3 as a 25 MHz oscillator for ST-LINK. Confirm board revision and clock configuration before using these values. Dual-core startup, pin reservations, build, and flash profiles remain open.
